title: Realistic Universal Base Build XL [Checkpoint/SDXL 1.0]
description:
Or RUBB XL as I like to call it.

If you wish to use this model with diffusers, I also have this model over on huggingface.

Usage

  • 1024x1024, 1024x1536, 1536x1024, but best at 1024x1024 for general usage

  • DPM++ 2M Karras

  • 100 steps - less than 10 steps is useless, 10-20 gives a reasonably converged image, 20-50 adds lots of detail, by 100 steps the image usually stops changing completely.

  • Hi Res Fix R-ESRGAN 4x+, denoising 0.2, 8 steps

  • Use the standard SDXL Refiner model

  • CFG 7.5 - 1-3 is interesting but lowish contrast. 4-8 is useful, 9 and above tends to get weird.

description:
A trigger-free style LoRA inspired by late-1960s children’s fantasy television, especially the practical creatures, costumes.

Puppet Planet ’69 gives scenes the look of a handmade television world: expressive sculpted faces, plush and fabric creatures, oversized props, painted scenery, theatrical colors, and soft studio lighting. The goal is the feeling of a camera photographing a physical fantasy set.

It’s designed to work with ordinary subject prompts. No trigger word is required, and you don’t need to add “whimsical,” “colorful,” or “photograph” to activate the style.

Recommended strength

  • Most compatible checkpoints: 0.8–1.0

  • Kroma: around 1.5 in my testing

title: KABE-photoreal — Photorealistic Backgrounds (Anima) [LORA/Anima]
description:
Background LoRA for Anima (anima_base v1.0). Turns illustrated backgrounds into photorealistic ones while the character stays clean 2D anime — and the character can interact with the photo environment (sitting on benches, standing in real streets, ripples in puddles).

Trigger: photoanime_mix

Recommended: weight 0.8 (0.7–1.0 usable), 768x1344, 20 steps, CFG 5, euler. Adding "photorealistic background" to the prompt helps. Works together with character LoRAs — the samples use anima_base + this LoRA + a character LoRA with a face-detailer finish.

Trained on anima_base v1.0, network dim 16. A merged checkpoint with this LoRA baked into anima_base at 0.8 is also available on my profile.

Note: The samples were generated with the companion merged checkpoint (same effect baked in).

License: free distribution under the original Anima license (no model sale).
author: kabedayo
